learn: A popular public-domain song can be filed as grouped VIN injections instead of one blob dump. Maple Leaf Rag (Scott Joplin, 1899) Wikimedia OGG is 263304 bytes / 53s. §VITAFILE§ base64 + 720 B VIN payload needs hundreds of packets — more than the hourly 24-chunk thrift cap. Split the original bitstream into slices whose encoded VIN count is ≤24, enqueue each group, drain with /vitafeed next → confirm|override. Player concatenates slices and plays audio/ogg. That is original blockchain playback — not a synthetic demo WAV and not a URL. Proven only when every group loc is a real Base Input Data hash. Formula anchors remain class proof. VITAFEED_PAID stays default OFF; never invent hashes; never sell red to place the song.
